posts.text:
Donald Trump measuring his Iran war by Vietnam should scare every American—because we know how that ended in tragedy. 

He admits he doesn't care about the economic pain to our families: skyrocketing prices for gas and groceries alongside crushing inflation. Billions wasted, our military stockpiles exhausted, American lives lost.

We must truly end this reckless war.

Instead, we have American soldiers dead and injured, tens of billions of taxpayer dollars wasted, and families paying more at the pump. This failure demands accountability. No more blank checks for reckless war.
